meta.summary: Hides app badges and sign-up link; also on facebook.com/messages: blur or hide chat list, pictures, bubbles; hides top bar, calls
meta.notes:
**2026-11-13: messenger.com is now only a landing page.** Meta ended messaging on messenger.com on 2026-04-16 and redirects computers to `facebook.com/messages` (TechCrunch 2026-02-19; Business Standard; IBTimes 2026-04). The recipe now also matches `https://www.facebook.com/messages` and `/messages/*`, so the options below work where chats actually live. The Facebook recipe matches the same pages; each recipe's options are saved separately.
- **LIVE** (iPhone UA 390x844, logged out, www.messenger.com/): `div[role="main"]:not(:has(footer)) div > img` matched 2 (the 330x479 and 1136x1648 phone pictures; the footer logo and header logo are excluded). `span:has(> a[href^="https://lm.messenger.com/l.php"])` still matched the badge spans (the phone layout showed the App Store badge).
- **SOURCE, not seen live (logged-in only; /messages redirects to login)**: `[role="navigation"] [role="row"]` chat rows and `div[role="banner"]` as the Facebook top bar (bankjaneo's Caprine fork css/browser.css, 2026); `div[aria-label="Thread list"]` (greasyfork Messenger Hide Chat List, 2024, written for messenger.com); `[role="grid"][aria-label^="Messages in conversation"]` with `role=row` bubbles (Shadeed 2021 article on the Messenger bubble). **INFERRED**: `Start a voice call` and `Start a video call` labels (English only) and the avatar `img` and `image` paths. Fixture `messages.html` is hand-written from these.
- `facebook-bar` is skipped while any `[role="dialog"]` exists, because Facebook mounts the photo viewer's Close button inside `role=banner` (Caprine notes).
- Not verified: that Thread list is still the label on facebook.com/messages; any chat. Hidden chat list means you cannot switch chats until the option is turned back to Show.

**Earlier checks (messenger.com landing and login)**

LIVE (headless Chromium, 2026-11-07 and 2026-11-08, Sri Lanka address, logged out). iPhone UA 390x844: www.messenger.com/ is a marketing landing page with no login form, cookie banner or pop-up; /login/ redirects to /. span:has(> a[href^="https://lm.messenger.com/l.php"]) matched 3 (Android, iOS and desktop badge spans). The #modalDialog template is display:none and #header-notices is empty; the Features_subnav menu is aria-hidden and not shown at this width, so none are hidden. Desktop UA 1280x800 /login/: only a login form (email, password, Continue, 'Keep me signed in' checkbox) plus a row 'Not on Facebook? | Forgotten password | Privacy Policy'; a[href^="https://www.facebook.com/r.php"] matched 1, outside the form. No cookie or consent banner, 'Get Messenger' or 'Continue as' prompt appeared in either layout (a consent dialog, if ever shown to EU users, is deliberately not hidden). NOT verified: the logged-in messenger UI (no account), banners or notifications after sign-in, EU/UK consent UI.
